invariants.rationale: states.get(++index) returns an UndoState; assuming states is a valid List and index stays in bounds, result should not be null.
Cursor typically refers to a position within text, which is usually non-negative.
Selection start denotes a position in text, which should not be negative.
The text argument is saved as the current state for undo, suggesting it should not be null.
If there is a selection, the start of the selection should be within the bounds of the text.
